findings.quote: were making a tour of the islands and the cities in Asia and spent the greatest part of their time in Rhodes, though in those days the Rhodians had no need of supervision
findings.problem: Greek has a lacuna (***) after τὰς κατὰ τὴν Ἀσίαν πόλεις, before πλεῖστον δ᾽ ἐν τῇ Ῥόδῳ; the English reads on as if whole. Also οὐ προσδεομένων τῶν Ῥωμαίων has no stated object ('supervision' is invented); the missing object presumably stood in the gap.
findings.proposed_fix: were making a tour of the islands and the cities in Asia [gap in the Greek] ... and most of all in Rhodes, although the Rhodians at that time did not need it

units.note: Lacuna marked by *** in Greek; object of προσδεομένων lost.

findings.quote: After the conference with the Romans and the Greek states, Perseus set down
findings.problem: Greek: μετὰ τὸν σύλλογον τὸν πρὸς τοὺς Ῥωμαίους, *** τῶν Ἑλλήνων, a lacuna after 'Romans' before τῶν Ἑλλήνων; the 'conference with ... the Greek states' is invented smoothing.
findings.proposed_fix: After the conference with the Romans, [gap in the Greek] ... of the Greeks, Perseus set down

findings.quote: Antenor and his colleagues did not accept that answer; but, satisfied with the rest
findings.problem: Greek: τὴν μὲν ἀπόκρισιν οὐκ ἔλαβον ***, τὴν δὲ λοιπὴν φιλανθρωπίαν ἀποδεξάμενοι: lacuna after οὐκ ἔλαβον; the verb is 'did not receive/take' with something lost, and 'did not accept' resolves it silently.
findings.proposed_fix: Antenor and his colleagues did not receive the answer [gap in the Greek] ...; but, satisfied with the rest

findings.quote: ordered them to leave Rome at once, and all other Macedonians who happened to be staying in Italy to depart within thirty days
findings.problem: Greek: προσέταξαν αὐτοῖς ἐκ μὲν τῆς Ῥώμης εὐθέως ἀπαλλάττεσθαι καὶ τοῖς ἄλλοις ἅπασιν Μακεδόσιν ... ἐκ δὲ τῆς Ἰταλίας ἐν τριάκονθ᾽ ἡμέραις ἐκχωρεῖν: the envoys AND the other Macedonians must leave Rome at once, and (all) leave Italy within thirty days. English attaches 'thirty days' only to the other Macedonians and drops the two-stage order.
findings.proposed_fix: ordered them and all the other Macedonians who happened to be staying there to leave Rome at once, and to leave Italy within thirty days

findings.quote: the remaining one to Tenedos under a commander named Timagoras
findings.problem: Greek: τὴν δὲ μίαν εἰς Τένεδον, ἐφ᾽ ἧς ἄρχων ἐπέπλει * Τιμαγόρας. There is a gap (*) before Τιμαγόρας; the text is damaged and the commander of the Tenedos ship is not securely named. English supplies 'a commander named Timagoras', duplicating the commander of the five ships, as if whole.
findings.proposed_fix: the remaining one to Tenedos, on which a commander sailed [gap in the Greek] ... Timagoras

units.note: Greek corrupt/lacunose at this point; who sailed to Tenedos is uncertain.
